principle: Advanced coverage never compensates for a foundational gap; repair only at true owner scope with append-only IDs.

gaps.title: Counting, cardinality and base-ten place value
gaps.current_state: C02 begins with abstract classification of N/Z/fractions and fraction operations; no explicit counting-as-cardinality, numeral-quantity correspondence, base-ten positional value, partitioning or zero-as-placeholder progression is present.
required_repair_meanings: count sequence and cardinality
numeral↔quantity representation
base-ten positional notation and digit value
compose/decompose whole numbers by place value
compare/order using place-value reasoning
zero as number and positional placeholder
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Do not reauthor set/cardinality theory from C01; own only school-level number representation and numerical meaning.

gaps.title: Whole-number and decimal arithmetic fluency, strategies and written methods
gaps.current_state: C02 has operation laws, order of operations and advanced arithmetic theorems, but not the foundational progression from addition/subtraction/multiplication/division meanings through mental strategies, fact fluency, place-value algorithms and reasonableness checking.
required_repair_meanings: addition/subtraction as combine/change/compare and inverse operations
multiplication as equal groups/arrays/scaling
division as sharing/grouping and inverse of multiplication
mental decomposition/compensation strategies
place-value-based written methods for multi-digit whole-number/decimal calculations
estimate and check reasonableness of results
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Algorithm implementation complexity remains future B1.5; C02 owns mathematical calculation methods and meanings.

gaps.title: Concrete-to-formal fractions and decimal place-value progression
gaps.current_state: C02 formally defines fractions, rational numbers, decimal expansions and operations, but does not encode the school progression through unit fractions, part-whole/measure/operator meanings, number-line placement, improper/mixed forms, decimal place value, and explicit fraction-decimal-percent connections.
required_repair_meanings: unit fraction and equal-part meaning
fractions as numbers on a number line
part-whole, quotient, measure and operator interpretations
equivalent fractions through scaling visual/quantitative meaning
proper/improper/mixed-number relationships
decimal place value through tenths/hundredths/etc
fraction↔decimal↔percent representations and comparison
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Formal rational/real structure already accepted remains unchanged; foundational representations are added beneath it.

gaps.title: Patterns, equality, unknowns and early algebraic generalisation
gaps.current_state: C03 starts with formal expressions/equations and algebraic functions. It does not explicitly encode the earlier progression from repeating/growing patterns, equality as a relation, missing-number/unknown reasoning, and expressing arithmetic regularities before formal symbolic manipulation.
required_repair_meanings: recognise/continue/describe repeating and growing patterns
identify a rule or invariant in a sequence/context
equality means same value rather than an instruction to calculate
use a symbol/box/letter for an unknown quantity
form and solve simple number sentences from contexts
generalise arithmetic relationships and connect tables/graphs/formulas progressively
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: C08 retains recurrence/combinatorial structures; C03 owns early algebraic meaning and symbolic generalisation.

gaps.title: Everyday measurement and unit reasoning
gaps.current_state: C04 covers exact geometric length/area/volume and unit scaling, but the general-education measurement progression across length, mass, capacity/volume, time, money, temperature, reading scales and everyday unit conversions is not represented. Physical metrology must remain B1.2-owned.
required_repair_meanings: compare measurable attributes before formal units
iterate/read standard units and scales
length, mass, capacity/volume and time units and conversions
calendar/clock duration and timetable reasoning
money amount/change/unit-price calculations as arithmetic context
temperature as numerical scale context
choose appropriate unit and estimate magnitude
distinguish mathematical unit conversion from physical instrument calibration/uncertainty
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: C04 owns mathematical measurement/units; B1.2-C01 retains physical measurement instruments, calibration and uncertainty.

gaps.title: Elementary 2-D/3-D shape and spatial reasoning
gaps.current_state: C04 D1 begins with congruence/similarity/convexity/regularity and later formal geometry. Foundational recognition/composition of common 2-D/3-D shapes, sides/faces/edges/vertices, spatial vocabulary, turns, simple coordinates, nets/views and concrete symmetry/transformations are not fully explicit.
required_repair_meanings: recognise/name/compare common 2-D and 3-D shapes across size/orientation
describe sides/edges/faces/vertices and simple shape properties
compose/decompose shapes and relate 2-D faces to 3-D solids
position/direction/movement and whole/half/quarter turns
horizontal/vertical/parallel/perpendicular as spatial relations
simple grids/coordinates and translations/reflections
nets/plans/views of simple solids where developmentally appropriate
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Formal Euclidean/analytic/transformation theory remains in existing C04 topics; foundational spatial meaning precedes it.

gaps.title: Data collection, simple displays and graphical literacy
gaps.current_state: C07 descriptive statistics already contains frequency, mean/median/spread/correlation and histogram semantics, but it skips the elementary progression through collecting/classifying data, tally/table/pictogram/bar/line/pie displays, reading scales, comparing categories and choosing a representation.
required_repair_meanings: pose a simple data question and define categories/variables
collect/classify/count observations
tally and frequency tables
pictograms/block/bar charts with scales
line/time graphs and pie charts when appropriate
read axes/scales/legends accurately
compare totals/categories and describe simple patterns
choose a display suited to data type and question
distinguish display choices from underlying data
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Future B1.5 owns software/data pipelines; C07 owns mathematical data representation and interpretation.

gaps.title: Chance language and experimental-to-formal probability progression
gaps.current_state: C07 D1 starts at measure-theoretic probability spaces and formal distributions. It lacks the foundational progression from impossible/possible/certain and more/less likely, through repeated simple experiments and relative frequency, to equally-likely finite sample spaces and the 0-1 probability scale.
required_repair_meanings: use everyday chance language consistently
order events by likelihood without requiring a numerical model
record outcomes/frequencies from repeated simple experiments
interpret relative frequency as empirical evidence that may vary
represent probability on a 0-to-1 scale
construct simple finite sample spaces
calculate probability by favorable/total outcomes only under equally-likely assumptions
distinguish experimental frequency from theoretical probability
gaps.no_duplicate_boundary: Measure-theoretic probability remains the accepted advanced formal layer; foundational chance meaning is added below it.

confirmed_non_gaps.item: rounding, numerical error, scale of magnitude
ratio, rate and percent formal arithmetic
mathematical modelling / numerical / optimization / finance extensions
